items.title: Pay dental invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag spätestens 30 Tage nach dem Rechnungsdatum auf das unten angegebene Konto.
items.computation: Start of period is the invoice date 04.09.2025 (Rechnungsdatum), not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB. Adding 30 days: remaining days in September after 4th = 26 (Sep 5–30), plus 4 days in October = 30 → 04.10.2025. This is a payment owed to a private business (not an authority), so the payer's own Land (NW) governs weekend/holiday shifts under §§ 269, 270 Abs. 4, 193 BGB. 04.10.2025 is a Saturday; the following day 05.10.2025 is a Sunday; neither is a NW public holiday obstacle otherwise, so the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 06.10.2025 (not a holiday in NW).
